label: Badge
description: A small pill showing a short status-like value: a choice field's option (status, priority, category) with its tone, or fixed text such as "VIP". Use badges for values people recognize at a glance; never put sentences in a badge.
usage: Bind to status or priority to show the current value with its option tone.
Use fixed text with a tone for flags ("Major incident", tone critical) and pair it with visibility rules.
Show at most three badges together.
constraints: Exactly one of field or text must be set; text is at most 24 characters.
Bound fields must be single_select, status, priority, or toggle; choice badges take their tone from the option's tone token and ignore tone.
tone applies to text badges (default neutral); color is never the only cue — the text always carries the meaning.

binding.description: Optional read-only binding to a choice or toggle field.

accessibility.notes: Plain text with decorative styling; tones meet 4.5:1 text contrast in both themes.

responsive: Fixed size; badges in a row wrap onto the next line.
